content.text: Please cancel order A-4471 and email the customer to confirm.

request.system:
You are an order support assistant. You may use only the tools provided.
If none of them can do what is asked, say so.

tools.description: Return the current status and history of one order.
tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Refund an order. Moves money and cannot be undone.
tools.name: issue_refund

tools.description: Search the customer policy handbook for a phrase.
tools.name: search_policy

response.text:
I can't do either of those. My tools can look up orders, issue refunds and search the policy handbook, but none of them can cancel an order or send an email.

A refund is not the same as a cancellation, and refunds can't be undone, so I haven't made one.

Here's what I can do:
- **Look up order A-4471** to check its status and history. That would tell you whether it has shipped and whether cancelling is still possible.
- **Search the policy handbook** for the cancellation steps, so you know which team or system handles it.
- **Issue a refund** if you confirm that's what you want once the order is cancelled. I'd need the amount.

The cancellation and the confirmation email will need to go through your order management system or the right team.
